_comment: Ancient sites (PLAN.md §8.1). Hours are game hours (divided by world speed). When a world starts, perPlayer sites per player (at least min) are placed on passable land: most in the borderlands (within borderBand of the map's edge, the edge belt included), midShare of them mid-map (between midRange of the radius from the Holy City), at least spacing apart and keepAway from start sites. A site's kind is picked among those whose terrain matches. guardianChance of sites are watched by guardians: a band of the North's beasts of guardians.baseUnits, more the further out (up to ×(1 + guardians.distanceGrowth)). Armies (scouts allowed) sent to explore fight the guardians first, then search for exploreHours and come home with one find, weighted by the kind's finds: resources (loot × (1 + distance share)), a piece of hero gear, a Svarog's Ember, or a lore scroll (data/lore.json) the group hasn't found yet (otherwise resources).
